name: tabvacuum
description: Find tabs fast, sort them your way, and clear duplicates, stale tabs and blank pages. Built for keyboard control.

scripts.test:firefox: npm run build && npm run test:search:firefox
scripts.test:chromium: npm run build && npm run test:search:chromium
scripts.test:browsers: npm run build && npm run test:search:firefox && npm run test:search:chromium && npm run test:stale:firefox && npm run test:stale:chromium && npm run test:age:chromium && npm run test:feedback:firefox && npm run test:feedback:chromium
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox/
scripts.start:chrome: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/chrome/ --target chromium
